verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a Gazebo simulation tutorial, and its topic-based pub/sub interfaces mean nodes talk to simulated or real hardware through the same messages. A long-time user also reports that ROS gives you sim 'for free' if you follow its conventions. However, no first-party doc explicitly states that the same robot code runs unchanged against both simulation and hardware, or explains how to swap between them. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of sim-to-real code reuse without changes (e.g., sim time handling or a hardware-abstraction layer for swapping sim and real drivers), hands-on corroboration of a sim-to-real transfer without a rewrite.
